note: The Greek (both TR and critical text) reads "elpidos" (hope); the KJV renders it "faith", its only such mistranslation, perhaps to avoid repeating "hope".

kjv: ye had compassion of me in my bonds
mine: you had compassion on those in prison
note: TR "tois desmois mou" (my bonds, assuming Pauline authorship) against "tois desmiois" (the prisoners; A, D*, 33).

kjv: Now the just shall live by faith
mine: but My (God's) righteous one shall live by faith
note: TR omits "mou" (my); P46, Sinaiticus, A have "ho dikaios mou".
